verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-as-a-service API platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The only agent-adjacent signals are an llms.txt file, REST APIs and webhooks, which are building blocks rather than the requested capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
